purpose: Teach: 漱石/空軍/レジャー/ヘリコプター/スタディ/ベクトル/マンハッタン/マダム

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんは漱石の小説を読んでらっしゃるわよ
lines.en: Sho — your father's been reading Soseki novels lately.
lines.style: Gently informative, as if sharing a small domestic observation. Warm but matter-of-fact. Light vocal weight on 'Soseki' — not lecturing, just noticing aloud.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼくのお祖父ちゃんが、昔空軍だったんだって
lines.en: Mom, did you know Grandpa used to be in the air force?
lines.style: Bright curiosity bubbling up. Quick, earnest delivery. The kind of sudden interest only a 6-year-old has — like he's just discovered something wonderful and needs to tell her right now.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんとレジャー施設に行きましょう
lines.en: Sho, why don't we go to the leisure center with your father sometime?
lines.style: Soft invitation, careful not to oversell it. Warm and present but giving him space to decide. The gentleness of suggesting something together without demanding enthusiasm.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、空のヘリコプター見たよ
lines.en: Mom, I saw a helicopter in the sky today.
lines.style: Eager to share, speaking quickly. The pride of having witnessed something — looking for her to be impressed. Open, unguarded, the way he delivers news that matters to him.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、ぼくのお部屋にスタディスペース作ろうね
lines.en: Sho, let's set up a little study space in your room, okay?
lines.style: Thoughtful suggestion delivered with quiet warmth. A beat of tenderness — not rushing, letting him settle into the idea. The practical mother who shows care through small improvements.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、数学のベクトル、お父さんに教わるよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad's teaching me vectors in math.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact pride. He's not showing off — just stating the fact with quiet satisfaction. The tone of someone doing something good and knowing it.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さん、マンハッタンに留学してたのよ
lines.en: Sho, your grandmother actually studied abroad in Manhattan for a while.
lines.style: Sharing a small family secret. Warmth with a thread of admiration running through it. Like she's revealing something about his grandmother he might not have known — fond, almost conspiratorial.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お祖母ちゃんって、マダムって感じよね
lines.en: Mom, Grandma really does have that 'madame' quality about her, doesn't she?
lines.style: Playful observation from a 6-year-old noticing something subtle about grown-ups. Light, almost conspiratorial — seeking her agreement. The closeness of sharing a joke about family.
